digest.title: Amazon earnings call 2026-10-30

architecture_signals.agent_product_usage_disclosure: AgentCore: 2x more agents deployed Q3 vs prior three quarters combined
architecture_signals.architecture_freetext: Amazon deploying Trainium for Bedrock inference at scale; custom silicon strategy balancing internal cloud use vs external sales starting late 2027; enterprise inference adoption accelerating with security and cost efficiency as primary drivers.

key_quotes: We still expect 2026 cash CapEx of approximately $220 billion, expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027.
AWS can grow north of 40% in each of 2027 and 2028 and be a trillion-dollar revenue business.
Bedrock token volume growing nearly 17x year-over-year, fastest growing multi-billion dollar service.

indicator_deltas.summary: Capex guidance holds flat at $220B for 2027 after 2026, with explicit statement of 'meaningfully more' planned, signaling continued aggressive acceleration rather than plateau.
indicator_deltas.prior_quote: We now believe we will spend approximately $220 billion in cash CapEx in 2026.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: We still expect 2026 cash CapEx of approximately $220 billion, expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027.

indicator_deltas.summary: Backlog grew 17% QoQ ($496B→$578B) with AWS capacity reserved 'lion's share' through 2027; custom silicon Trainium commitment growth at 2000% YoY signals intensifying internal HBM demand and reduced external supply availability.

New indicator entry in current call. AWS backlog $578B triple-digit YoY growth with 40% revenue growth projection 2027–2028 creates structural capex-revenue coupling; trillion-dollar AWS target (5–10 years) locks multi-year capex commitment.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: AWS can grow north of 40% in each of 2027 and 2028 and be a trillion-dollar revenue business.

language_dropped: higher cost of memory pushing this number up from prior estimate of $200B (no prior guidance restatement in Q4 call)
